4.texto_original: ¶ Aku terus weruh dampar-dampar. Sing njagong nang dampar-dampar mau éntuk pangwasa ngrutu. Aku uga weruh nyawané wong-wong sing diketok guluné, jalaran pada nyeksèni Gusti Yésus lan pada ngabarké pituturé Gusti Allah. Wong-wong kuwi durung tau sembah-sujut marang kéwan lan marang retyané lan uga ora nampani tengeré kéwan nang batuké lan nang tangané. Wong-wong kuwi kabèh urip menèh lan pada mèlu dadi ratu karo Kristus sèwu taun suwéné.

"Aku terus weruh wong-wong sing wis pada mati, gedé-tyilik, pada ngadek nang ngarepé damparé. Nang kono ènèng buku-buku sing wis kebukak, terus ènèng buku liyané dibukak, yakuwi Buku Panguripan. Wong-wong terus pada dikrutu miturut penggawéné kaya sing ketulis nang buku-buku mau."

The original language presents significant lexical and syntactic elements. Key terms reveal theological distinctions often lost in translation.

Historical-Critical Context

Source criticism and form criticism illuminate the compositional history. The Sitz im Leben reflects socio-religious dynamics of antiquity.

Theological Implications

This verse contributes to covenant theology, divine sovereignty, human responsibility, and eschatological hope.

Archaeological Evidence

Recent discoveries from the ancient Near East provide material context for interpreting this passage.
